arxiv-2012-06871.title: Exact Solution of Hartemann-Luhmann Equation of Motion for a Charged Particle interacting with an Intense Electromagnetic Wave/Pulse
arxiv-2012-06871.creator: Shivam Kumar Mishra, Sudip Sengupta
arxiv-2012-06871.description: Abstract We report an exact solution of the Hartemann-Luhmann equation of motion for a charged particle interacting with an intense electromagnetic wave/pulse. It is found that the radiation reaction force has a significant affect on the charged particle dynamics and the particle shows, on average, a net energy gain over a period of time.

arxiv-2101-09523.title: Debiasing Pre-trained Contextualised Embeddings
arxiv-2101-09523.creator: Masahiro Kaneko, Danushka Bollegala
arxiv-2101-09523.description: Abstract In comparison to the numerous debiasing methods proposed for the static non-contextualised word embeddings, the discriminative biases in contextualised embeddings have received relatively little attention. We propose a fine-tuning method that can be applied at token- or sentence-levels to debias pre-trained contextualised embeddings.

arxiv-2203-10692.title: Better Language Model with Hypernym Class Prediction
arxiv-2203-10692.creator: He Bai, Tong Wang, Alessandro Sordoni, Peng Shi
arxiv-2203-10692.description: Abstract Class-based language models (LMs) have been long devised to address context sparsity in n n -gram LMs. In this study, we revisit this approach in the context of neural LMs. We hypothesize that class-based prediction leads to an implicit context aggregation for similar words and thus can improve generalization for rare words.

arxiv-2208-13012.title: A Descriptive Method of Firm Size Transition Dynamics Using Markov Chain
arxiv-2208-13012.description: Abstract Social employment, which is mostly carried by firms of different types, determines the prosperity and stability of a country. As time passing, the fluctuations of firm employment can reflect the process of creating or destroying jobs. Therefore, it is instructive to investigate the firm employment (size) dynamics.

arxiv-2211-06434.title: Plasmoid Instability in the Multiphase Interstellar Medium Journal: ApJL
arxiv-2211-06434.creator: Drummond B. Fielding, Bart Ripperda, Alexander A. Philippov
arxiv-2211-06434.description: Abstract The processes controlling the complex clump structure, phase distribution, and magnetic field geometry that develops across a broad range of scales in the turbulent interstellar medium remains unclear. Using unprecedentedly high resolution three-dimensional magnetohydrodynamic simulations of thermally unstable turbulent systems, we show that large current sheets unstable to plasmoid-mediated reconnection form regularly throughout the volume.

arxiv-2212-13040.title: Bijective proof of a conjecture on unit interval posets
arxiv-2212-13040.creator: Wenjie Fang
arxiv-2212-13040.description: Abstract In a recent preprint, Matherne, Morales and Selover conjectured that two different representations of unit interval posets are related by the famous zeta map in q , t q,t -Catalan combinatorics. This conjecture was proved recently by Gélinas, Segovia and Thomas using induction.

arxiv-2305-07457.title: Perturbation-based QE: An Explainable, Unsupervised Word-level Quality Estimation Method for Blackbox Machine Translation
arxiv-2305-07457.creator: \name Tu Anh Dinh \addr tu.dinh@kit.edu, \name Jan Niehues \addr jan.niehues@kit.edu
arxiv-2305-07457.description: Abstract Quality Estimation (QE) is the task of predicting the quality of Machine Translation (MT) system output, without using any gold-standard translation references. State-of-the-art QE models are supervised: they require human-labeled quality of some MT system output on some datasets for training, making them domain-dependent and MT-system-dependent.

arxiv-2306-03847.title: Learning Human Mesh Recovery in 3D Scenes
arxiv-2306-03847.creator: Zehong ShenZhi CenSida PengQing ShuaiHujun Bao, Xiaowei Zhou[1.5mm] State Key Lab of CAD&CG, Zhejiang University
arxiv-2306-03847.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Zehong ShenZhi CenSida PengQing ShuaiHujun Bao, Xiaowei Zhou[1.5mm] State Key Lab of CAD&CG, Zhejiang University. We present a novel method for recovering the absolute pose and shape of a human in a pre-scanned scene given a single image. Unlike previous methods that perform scene-aware mesh optimization, we propose to first estimate absolute position and dense scene contacts with a sparse 3D CNN, and later enhance a pretrained human mesh recovery network by cross-attention with the derived 3D scene cues.

arxiv-2310-06593.title: DIAS-STP-23-12 A smoking gun signature of the 3HDM
arxiv-2310-06593.creator: [-10mm] A. Dey, V. Keus, S. Moretti, C. Shepherd-Themistocleous, [0.15cm] Dublin Institute for Advanced Studies, School of Theoretical Physics 10 Burlington road, Dublin, D04 C932, Ireland
arxiv-2310-06593.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by [-10mm] A. Dey, V. Keus, S. Moretti, C. Shepherd-Themistocleous, [0.15cm] Dublin Institute for Advanced Studies, School of Theoretical Physics 10 Burlington road, Dublin, D04 C932, Ireland. We analyse new signals of a 3-Higgs Doublet Model (3HDM) at the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) where only one doublet acquires a Vacuum Expectation Value (VEV), preserving a Z 2 Z_{2} parity.

arxiv-2402-06836.title: Source Confusion from Neutron Star Binaries in Ground-Based Gravitational Wave Detectors is Minimal
arxiv-2402-06836.creator: Aaron D. Johnson, Katerina Chatziioannou, Will M. Farr
arxiv-2402-06836.description: Abstract Upgrades beyond the current second generation of ground-based gravitational wave detectors will allow them to observe tens of thousands neutron star and black hole binaries. Given the typical minute-to-hour duration of neutron star signals in the detector frequency band, a number of them will overlap in the time-frequency plane resulting in a nonzero cross-correlation.

arxiv-2406-14897.title: Understanding the variability of helium abundance in the solar corona using three-fluid modeling and UV observations
arxiv-2406-14897.creator: Leon Ofman, Yogesh, Silvio Giordano
arxiv-2406-14897.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Leon Ofman, Yogesh, Silvio Giordano. The variability of helium abundance in the solar corona and the solar wind is an important signature of solar activity, solar cycle, solar wind sources, as well as coronal heating processes.

arxiv-2503-02850.title: Exact matching as an alternative to propensity score matching
arxiv-2503-02850.creator: Ekkehard Glimm, Lillian Yau
arxiv-2503-02850.description: Abstract Abstract The comparison of different medical treatments from observational studies or across different clinical studies is often biased by confounding factors such as systematic differences in patient demographics or in the inclusion criteria for the trials. Propensity score matching is a popular method to adjust for such confounding. It compares weighted averages of patient responses.

arxiv-2507-23679.title: Swap Network Augmented Ansätze on Arbitrary Connectivity
arxiv-2507-23679.creator: Teodor Parella-Dilmé, Jakob S. Kottmann, Antonio Acín
arxiv-2507-23679.description: Abstract Efficient parametrizations of quantum states are essential for trainable hybrid classical-quantum algorithms. A key challenge in their design consists in adapting to the available qubit connectivity of the quantum processor, which limits the capacity to generate correlations between distant qubits in a resource-efficient and trainable manner.

arxiv-2508-16445.title: Using LLMs and Essence to Support Software Practice Adoption
arxiv-2508-16445.creator: Sonia Nicoletti, Paolo Ciancarini
arxiv-2508-16445.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Sonia Nicoletti, Paolo Ciancarini. Recent advancements in natural language processing (NLP) have enabled the development of automated tools that support various domains, including software engineering. However, while NLP and artificial intelligence (AI) research has extensively focused on tasks such as code generation, less attention has been given to automating support for the adoption of best practices, the evolution of ways of working, and the monitoring of process health.

pmc-10821680.description: CONTEXT:Circulating neutrophils and long noncoding RNAs (lncRNAs) play various roles in intracranial atherosclerotic stenosis (ICAS).OBJECTIVE:Our study aimed to detect differentially expressed (DE) lncRNAs and mRNAs in circulating neutrophils and explore the pathogenesis of atherosclerosis from the perspective of neutrophils.METHODS:Nineteen patients with ICAS and 15 healthy controls were enrolled. The peripheral blood of the participants was collected, and neutrophils were separated.

pmc-11574378.title: Performance du score GPR dans la prédiction non invasive de la fibrose hépatique chez des patients tunisiens atteints de l’hépatite B chroniqu
pmc-11574378.creator: Ikbel Ghachem, Lamine Hamzaoui, Asma Bachali, Chayma Rhimi, Mouna Medhioub, Moufida Mahmoudi, Amal Khsiba, Mohamed Msaddak Azouz
pmc-11574378.description: RESUMEIntroduction: Plusieurs tests non invasifs (TNI) ont été rapportés dans la prédiction de la fibrose hépatique afin d'éviter la ponction biopsie de foie (PBF). Objectif: Évaluer la performance des TNI chez les patients tunisiens atteints d'hépatite B chronique (HBC). pmc-11710345.title: Depression, Depression Treatments, and Risk of Incident Dementia: A Prospective Cohort Study of 354,313 Participants
pmc-11710345.creator: Liu Yang, Jin‐Tai Yu
pmc-11710345.description: BackgroundTo investigate the associations between courses of depression, the application of depression treatment, and the risk of incident dementia.MethodIn this prospective cohort study, 354,313 participants aged 50 to 70 years were recruited from the UK Biobank between 2006 and 2010, and were followed‐up until 2020, with a total of 4,212,929 person‐years.

pmc-12379790.title: Mastoid Obliteration Using S53P4 Bioactive Glass Versus Mastoidectomy Alone for Refractory Chronic Suppurative Otitis Media
pmc-12379790.creator: Victor J. Kroon, David R. Colnot, Steven W. Mes, Pepijn A. Borggreven, Rick van de Langenberg, Jasper J. Quak
pmc-12379790.description: ObjectiveTo present the outcomes of mastoid obliteration using S53P4 bioactive glass (BAG) for refractory chronic suppurative otitis media (CSOM) and compare these to mastoidectomy alone.Study DesignRetrospective comparative cohort study.SettingSingle-center study.PatientsAll cases that underwent a canal wall up (CWU) mastoidectomy between 2010 and 2022 for refractory CSOM.

pmc-12590627.title: APPL1 concentration as a potential biomarker in early-onset preeclampsia: correlations with adiponectin-leptin dysregulation and adverse neonatal outcomes
pmc-12590627.creator: Qianmeng Zhu, Yuzhen Zhou, Yan Huang, Xiaoli Chi
pmc-12590627.description: BackgroundPreeclampsia (PE) is a severe pregnancy complication associated with metabolic dysregulation. APPL1 (adaptor protein, phosphotyrosine interacting with PH domain and leucine zipper 1) is a critical adaptor protein in adiponectin (ADP) and insulin signaling. Its role in preeclampsia (PE) remains underexplored.

pmc-12715147.title: Protecting the Heart in Motion: The Role of Physical Activity and Cardiorespiratory Fitness in Preventing Sudden Cardiac Death
pmc-12715147.creator: Setor K. Kunutsor, Khushmanjot Kaur, Jari A. Laukkanen
pmc-12715147.description: Sudden cardiac death (SCD) remains one of the most devastating manifestations of cardiovascular disease. While traditional risk stratification has focused on structural heart disease and electrophysiological markers, growing evidence suggests that modifiable lifestyle factors—particularly physical activity (PA) and cardiorespiratory fitness (CRF)—play a critical role in mitigating the risk of SCD.

pmc-12748772.title: Predicting imminent suicide risk in a crisis hotline chat using machine learning
pmc-12748772.creator: Yossi Levi-Belz, Meytal Grimland, Yael Segal-Elbak, Noam Munz, Hadas Yeshayahu, Joy Benatov, Avi Segal, Loona Ben Dayan, Inbar Shenfeld, Kobi Gal
pmc-12748772.description: Identifying individuals at the highest risk of suicide in real time is one of the critical tasks in suicide prevention. However, understanding the mental processes of at-risk individuals is a formidable endeavor due to the rapid, impulsive, and temporally dynamic characteristics of severe suicide crises.
